body.purpose: Readable descriptions, labels, and form copy.

label.purpose: Indexes, navigation metadata, and operational details.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals and deliberate lift transitions.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and navigation state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Blue action with compact editorial padding.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#2F6F95; color:#fff; padding:14px 24px; border-radius:8px; font:700 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif; transition:transform 300ms,background 300ms,box-shadow 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1C4B69; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 12px 24px -12px rgba(47,111,149,.5); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F6F95; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Warm paper field with mineral stroke.
components.css: .ds-field { width:100%; background:#F7F4ED; color:#182328; border:1px solid #CDD5D3; border-radius:8px; padding:14px 16px; font:400 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus { border-color:#2F6F95; outline:2px solid rgba(47,111,149,.18); outline-offset:1px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Indexed mono rail with one blue action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:16px 24px; background:rgba(247,244,237,.95); border-bottom:1px solid #CDD5D3; } .ds-nav a { color:#4C5B60; font:600 10px 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#182328; } .ds-nav button { background:#2F6F95; color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 16px; font:700 13px 'DM Sans',sans-serif; }

components.name: Plan Card
components.description: Quiet comparison surface with a blue selected state.
components.css: .ds-plan { background:#FFFDF8; color:#182328; border:1px solid #CDD5D3; border-radius:12px; padding:32px; } .ds-plan:hover { border-color:rgba(47,111,149,.5); transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 20px 35px -18px rgba(47,111,149,.24); }

narrative.overview: ForgeWell is expressed as a light editorial field journal for disciplined progress. Warm paper surfaces carry deep ink typography, structured rules, facility photography, and small signal marks that feel more like a coach's notation than generic fitness decoration.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Coral and yellow are directional marks, not a second body palette.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the display face for meaning and the mono face for measurement.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a shadow through hierarchy or interaction.

dos: Do use real ForgeWell photography as proof.
Do use rules, indexes, and measured metadata.
donts: Don't turn the page into a generic dark-gym theme.
Don't rebuild every section as a repeated icon-plus-card grid.
